tagline: Leading Global Vacation Ownership and Experience Company
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of the company's operational health, reflecting the pace of vacation ownership product sales and customer demand

kpis.name: Contract Sales
kpis.explanation: Vacation ownership contracts signed during the period, including resale contracts
kpis.description: Contract sales reflect the total amount of VOI contracts signed during the period, reduced by actual cancellations, and represent a key measure of the company's sales pace
kpis.signal: Key indicator of sales velocity and customer demand

kpis.name: Vacation Ownership Notes Receivable
kpis.explanation: Outstanding receivables related to customer financing of vacation ownership acquisitions
kpis.description: Vacation ownership notes receivable represent amounts owed by customers for financed contracts and reflect the company's exposure to credit risk
kpis.signal: Indicator of financing portfolio and credit risk exposure

kpis.name: Financing Propensity
kpis.explanation: Percentage of financed contracts among all originated vacation ownership sales contracts
kpis.description: Financing propensity is calculated as the volume of financed contracts divided by the total volume of originated contracts, excluding resale sales, and reflects customer tendency to use financing for purchases
kpis.signal: Indicator of customer purchasing behavior and financing capacity

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions the risk of cyberattacks in Item 1A, indicating that it could disrupt operations, damage reputation, and result in costs, fines, or litigation. The language used is strong, highlighting the critical importance of this risk.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company discloses ongoing litigation in Item 3, indicating that the outcomes of these proceedings could impact its business and financial results. Management believes the outcomes will not materially harm the financial position, but the inherent nature of litigation creates uncertainty.

risks.title: Credit and Financing Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company provides significant financing to its customers for vacation ownership purchases. Payment defaults and changes in allowance estimates for credit losses could have a significant impact on financial results.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive vacation and vacation ownership market. Competition could impact sales volumes and margins.

risks.title: Dependence on Marriott Brands and Other Partners
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on exclusive licenses of prestigious brands (Marriott Vacation Club, Hyatt, Ritz-Carlton, Westin, Sheraton) for its sales and management activities. Any disruption to these relationships could significantly affect operations.

ai_positioning.summary: The company VAC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report. The information provided focuses on the company's financial and operational aspects, with no reference to AI or related technology.
